# Vervant PDF API

> Vervant is being built to help SaaS developers turn their HTML into consistent PDFs. The hosted API is still being prepared; the public site, guides and browser-only invoice preview are available now.

## Product

The goal is simple: make PDF generation one less piece of infrastructure for a SaaS team to maintain.

Vervant is building an HTTP API for developers who need invoices, receipts, statements and reports from their own HTML or reusable templates.

Verified prototype functionality includes:
- HTML-to-PDF generation.
- Reusable Handlebars templates.
- API-key creation and revocation.
- Monthly usage limits and generation history.
- Page JavaScript disabled while rendering.
- Outbound and local network requests blocked during rendering.
- A4, Letter, Legal and Tabloid output, margins, background printing and landscape output.
- HTML limited to 1 MB, CSS limited to 256 KB, request body limited to 2 MB, and bounded rendering concurrency.

## Plan your PDF workflow

- Workflow brief planner: https://vervant-public-site.onrender.com/tools/workflow-brief/
- Helps developers summarize document types, volume, backend stack, current approach, pain points and template needs.
- Runs entirely in the browser; answers are not uploaded, stored or sent to Vervant. The summary can be copied and shared manually.

## Try a sample invoice

- Invoice preview builder: https://vervant-public-site.onrender.com/tools/invoice-preview/
- Runs in the visitor's browser. It does not upload, store or transmit invoice information.
- It uses browser print-to-PDF and is a layout demonstration, not the hosted Vervant API or tax/accounting software.

## A note on security and availability

The local prototype now launches Chromium inside an outer Bubblewrap boundary with isolated user, network, PID, IPC and UTS namespaces, dropped capabilities, a read-only root filesystem, masked home/application/data paths and a per-render temporary profile. The browser uses a debugging pipe and receives no API secrets. A local test confirms that Chromium cannot reach a service on the host’s localhost address. Chromium's own --no-sandbox flag remains enabled inside the outer boundary. The production Docker image passes its PDF and network-isolation smoke test in GitHub Actions using a disposable CI container with explicit namespace permissions. The test confirms `sandbox=bubblewrap`, `hostNetwork=blocked`, `hostRequests=0`, and valid PDF output. This is not a production deployment. Railway has confirmed that standard services do not expose the seccomp/AppArmor controls needed by this renderer, so the hosted API remains offline until a compatible VM or managed runtime has been tested. We will not disable container protections to make a service start. The hosted API is still offline while a compatible production host is being selected and tested. Please do not send production, personal, confidential or sensitive customer documents. The prototype has not received an independent security audit or certification.

## Availability

You can visit the website, read the guides and try the invoice preview today. Hosted PDF generation, public registration and live payments are not open yet.

## Vervant Local — business catalogues and quote enquiries

Vervant Local is a done-for-you, mobile-first catalogue for manufacturers, fabricators, printers, custom shops and installation businesses. It organizes products or services and guides buyers to submit more complete quote enquiries. It complements a business's existing website; it is not a hosted ecommerce platform.

- International information and pilot offer: https://vervant-public-site.onrender.com/negocios/en/
- Interactive English catalogue builder: https://vervant-public-site.onrender.com/negocios/en/builder/
- Industry directory: https://vervant-public-site.onrender.com/negocios/en/industries/
- Furniture and joinery: https://vervant-public-site.onrender.com/negocios/en/industries/furniture-makers/
- Metal fabrication and CNC: https://vervant-public-site.onrender.com/negocios/en/industries/metal-fabrication-cnc/
- Signage and print: https://vervant-public-site.onrender.com/negocios/en/industries/signage-print/
- Packaging and commercial print: https://vervant-public-site.onrender.com/negocios/en/industries/packaging-print/
- Commercial interiors and fit-out: https://vervant-public-site.onrender.com/negocios/en/industries/commercial-interiors/

The international pilot is USD 199 one-time for the first three projects, with up to 12 listings, responsive styling, search, categories, an enquiry flow via business email and/or WhatsApp, one revision round and self-contained HTML handover. Hosting, paid domains, ecommerce, payments, inventory, CRM, integrations and ongoing maintenance are not included unless separately quoted. The builder runs in the visitor's browser; form data is handed to the business's email or WhatsApp app rather than being submitted to a Vervant server.

The El Salvador pilot is a separate local offer and must not be quoted as the worldwide price.
